descriptions.tsonnet_c29_slot_mark_801e59b4: Finds a slot pointer in the 16-entry 64-byte table at 0x8045dbc8 and, if its armed flag is set, clears the top two flag bits (mode -1) or sets the top bit, then calls the slot update helper; field meanings are inferred. If no slot matches, the original accesses before the table; portable behavior is not established.
descriptions.tsonnet_c29_slots_release_801e5e74: When the owner's list flag is set, clears the top flag bits of each valid table slot named by its 16-bit indices, calls the slot update helper, marks the index unused (0xffff), then clears the list flag bits; field meanings are inferred. The valid domain of the list count is unverified.
